key.name: ask-selection
key.summary: Ask the agent about the selected text
key.description: The text selected in any window goes to the AI agent as quoted data, with a question, in a terminal. Only while the agentic features are on. An empty list turns it off.

key.name: pill
key.summary: The agent's changes in the live pill
key.description: While the agent may make changes and runs, the live pill lists each change its tools make, each with Undo, and Stop.

key.name: ask-here
key.summary: Ask the agent in the pill
key.description: Opens a field in the live pill's card: the chosen agent answers there, with Amethystora's tools that only read and no terminal. Only while the agentic features are on, and only for an agent that has a mode that changes nothing. An empty list turns it off. Super+Shift+Space is the next keyboard layout, so this is Super+/.

key.name: ask-questions
key.summary: The agent's questions in the pill
key.description: The agent's tools ask before they run a command for you: the question comes as a card in the live pill, with the exact command, Allow and Not now. Off, they ask in a terminal as before. A root command's password is asked by sudo either way.

key.name: ask-about
key.summary: Ask the agent about a picture or a text file
key.description: Offered, off until chosen. A picture or text file dropped on the pill's Ask the agent, or a picture copied when Super+Shift+A finds no selected text, is shown with what will be sent and to whom, and is sent only after Send and ask. A copy of the picture lives in the account's runtime folder while the question is answered. Never while the screen is shared.

key.name: routines
key.description: Routines you made (ame agent routines): each is sealed in the Vault and names one trigger (a time, a network, an app, the screen, the battery, a phone) and what to do, as apps to open and ame commands, never root and never a shell line. Only what a routine names is listened for, each run shows in the pill once with Undo and Pause, and with no routine made nothing is asked. Off, none runs.

key.name: doing
key.summary: One line in the pill about what the agent is reading
key.description: While the agent's tools read (search, read, state, logs, history), the live pill says which one in a few words, with a tick when it is done. Only the tool's name is shown, never what it read.
